72778-a-history-of-the-brazil.creator: Unknown
72778-a-history-of-the-brazil.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The object of this Work is to describe the state of the Brazil, from its first discovery down to the present time;--to trace distinctly the boundaries of the twenty-two provinces which it comprises, their sub-divisions into comarcas or districts, and their rivers; to enumerate the povoaçoes or establishments in each province, consisting of cities, towns, (and the dates they were so erected by his present Majesty, or previously,) _freguezias_, (parishes,) _arraials_, _aldeias_, (villages,) _presidios_, (garrisons,) hermitages, &c.

arxiv-2012-12591.title: Comparison of Privacy-Preserving Distributed Deep Learning Methods in Healthcare
arxiv-2012-12591.creator: Manish Gawali, Arvind C S, Shriya Suryavanshi, Harshit Madaan, Ashrika Gaikwad, Bhanu Prakash KN, Viraj Kulkarni, Aniruddha Pant
arxiv-2012-12591.description: Abstract In this paper, we compare three privacy-preserving distributed learning techniques: federated learning, split learning, and SplitFed. We use these techniques to develop binary classification models for detecting tuberculosis from chest X-rays and compare them in terms of classification performance, communication and computational costs, and training time.

arxiv-2102-03964.title: Migration in the Stencil Pluralist Cloud Architecture CCS: Networks Network architectures
arxiv-2102-03964.creator: Tai Liu, Zain Tariq, Barath Raghavan, Jay Chen
arxiv-2102-03964.description: Abstract . A debate in the research community has buzzed in the background for years: should large-scale Internet services be centralized or decentralized? Now-common centralized cloud and web services have downsides—user lock-in and loss of privacy and data control—that are increasingly apparent.

arxiv-2203-00343.title: Read before Generate! Faithful Long Form Question Answering with Machine Reading
arxiv-2203-00343.creator: Dan Su, Xiaoguang Li, Jindi Zhang, Lifeng Shang, Xin Jiang, Qun Liu, Pascale Fung
arxiv-2203-00343.description: Abstract Long-form question answering (LFQA) aims to generate a paragraph-length answer for a given question. While current work on LFQA using large pre-trained model for generation are effective at producing fluent and somewhat relevant content, one primary challenge lies in how to generate a faithful answer that has less hallucinated content.

arxiv-2303-08755.title: A Wigner quasiprobability distribution of work
arxiv-2303-08755.creator: Federico Cerisola, Franco Mayo, Augusto J. Roncaglia
arxiv-2303-08755.description: Abstract In this article we introduce a quasiprobability distribution of work that is based on the Wigner function. This construction rests on the idea that the work done on an isolated system can be coherently measured by coupling the system to a quantum measurement apparatus.

arxiv-2310-14174.title: An In-Context Schema Understanding Method for Knowledge Base Question Answering
arxiv-2310-14174.creator: Yantao Liu, Zixuan Li, Xiaolong Jin, Yucao Guo, Long Bai, Saiping Guan Jiafeng GuoXueqi Cheng School of Computer Science and Technology, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences;CAS Key Laboratory of Network Data Science and Technology,Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences.
arxiv-2310-14174.description: Abstract The Knowledge Base Question Answering (KBQA) task aims to answer natural language questions based on a given knowledge base. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities in language understanding and can be used to solve this task. In doing so, a major challenge for LLMs is to overcome the immensity and heterogeneity of knowledge base schemas.

pmc-10571907.title: Effect of Dietary Soy Protein Source on Effluent Water Quality and Growth Performance of Rainbow Trout Reared in a Serial Reuse Water System
pmc-10571907.creator: Thomas L. Welker, Ken Overturf
pmc-10571907.description: Simple SummaryFishmeal is a finite resource that continues to serve as the primary protein source in feeds of salmonids, including rainbow trout. Partial or total replacement of fishmeal has been successful, but many of these substitutions are of plant origin containing anti-nutritional factors that negatively impact growth and limit their dietary inclusion level.

pmc-10588914.title: The Status of Geriatric In-Hospital Nursing Care from the Perspective of Nurses Working in the Emergency Department of Hospitals in the Northwest of Iran in 2020
pmc-10588914.creator: Indira Modarres Sadraei, Behrouz Dadkhah, Naser Mozaffari, Mohammad Ali Mohammadi
pmc-10588914.description: Background:The evaluation of geriatric care in the emergency departments is necessary to improve the quality of care. This study aimed to determine the status of geriatric nursing care from the perspective of nurses working in the emergency department of hospitals.Materials and Methods:This study was a cross-sectional research study.

pmc-11451198.title: The effect of guided group reflection on the ability and convenience of breaking bad news in pre-hospital emergency staff
pmc-11451198.creator: Mohammad Reza Zarezadeh, Samaneh Mirzaei, Seyed Mohammad Javad Mirjalili, Khadijeh Nasiriani
pmc-11451198.description: BackgroundBad news refers to any information that create negative changes in a person’s understanding or expectations of in present and future. Breaking Bad News (BBN) is a stressful task that may have disturbing effects on the professional performance and general health of the medical staff. Pre-hospital emergency staff often needs to deliver bad news to the patient or his family.

pmc-11678867.title: Current Role of CT Pulmonary Angiography in Pulmonary Embolism: A State-of-the-Art Review
pmc-11678867.creator: Ignacio Diaz-Lorenzo, Alberto Alonso-Burgos, Alfonsa Friera Reyes, Ruben Eduardo Pacios Blanco, Maria del Carmen de Benavides Bernaldo de Quiros, Guillermo Gallardo Madueño
pmc-11678867.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The purpose of this study is to conduct a literature review on the current role of computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA) in the diagnosis and prognosis of pulmonary embolism (PE). It addresses key topics such as the quantification of the thrombotic burden, its role as a predictor of mortality, new diagnostic techniques that are available, the possibility of analyzing the thrombus composition to differentiate its evolutionary stage, and the applicability of artificial intelligence (AI) in PE through CTPA.

pmc-12473276.title: Lamb Wave-Based Damage Fusion Detection of Composite Laminate Panels Using Distance Analysis and Evidence Theory
pmc-12473276.creator: Li Wang, Guoqiang Liu, Xiaguang Wang, Yu Yang, Ricardo Perera, Xinqun Zhu
pmc-12473276.description: The Lamb wave-based damage detection method shows great potential for composite impact failure assessments. However, the traditional single signal feature-based methods only depend on partial structural state monitoring information, without considering the inconsistency of damage sensitivity and detection capability for different signal features.

pmc-12511363.title: Comparative study of fish adaptation at cellular and genetic levels across eco-sensitive zones with contrasting oxygen and temperature regimes
pmc-12511363.creator: Anupam Podder, Soumyadip Panja, Krishna Gangopadhyay, Atreyee Chaudhuri, Sumit Homechaudhuri
pmc-12511363.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Unravelling the physiological adaptations that enable fish to thrive under diverse environmental stressors is crucial for predicting their resilience to climate change. However, linking molecular mechanisms to ecological contexts remains a significant challenge and such studies are greatly lacking. To close this data gap, we conducted a physiological and molecular mechanisms-integrated comparative study of representative fish species from two ecologically contrasting regions: the Indian Sundarban mangrove estuary and the Sub-Himalayan Terai-Dooars hill streams.

pmc-13043775.title: Investigating uncharacterised genes in Saccharomyces cerevisiae using robot scientists
pmc-13043775.creator: Erik Y Bjurström, Alexander H Gower, Praphapan Lasin, Otto I Savolainen, Ievgeniia A Tiukova, Ross D King
pmc-13043775.description: Despite extensive research on Saccharomyces cerevisiae functional genomics, approximately 880 out of ~6,000 open reading frames (ORFs) remain uncharacterised. In this study we propose a method for characterising genes with limited prior functional knowledge using an automated laboratory platform, in conjunction with several hypothesis instantiation methods.

pmc-13072528.title: Plasma biomarkers of Alzheimer’s disease and their association with disproportionately enlarged subarachnoid space hydrocephalus
pmc-13072528.creator: Camilo Bermudez, Ekaterina Hofrenning, Angela J Fought, Jeffrey L Gunter, Petrice M Cogswell, David T Jones, Christopher G Schwarz, Val Lowe, Benjamin D Elder, Ronald C Petersen, Prashanthi Vemuri, Alicia Algeciras-Schimnich, Michelle M Mielke, David S Knopman, Neill R Graff-Radford, Clifford R Jack
pmc-13072528.description: BackgroundIndividuals with both Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) dynamics disorders, such as idiopathic normal-pressure hydrocephalus (iNPH), exhibit reduced CSF Aβ42 levels, complicating the interpretation of AD biomarkers. However, the influence of CSF dynamics on blood-based AD biomarkers remains unclear.

pmc-13079781.title: The optimization of neuroprosthetic interfaces relying on biophysical and surrogate digital twins
pmc-13079781.creator: Claudio Verardo, Veronica Fossati, Laura Toni, Luca Pierantoni, Elena Losanno, Filippo Agnesi, Simone Romeni
pmc-13079781.description: The electrical stimulation of the nervous system has shown great clinical potential in injury and pathology, yet experimentally driven practice makes it challenging to identify effective design choices and personalized stimulation protocols. This review outlines emerging model-based optimization frameworks that address these challenges by leveraging biophysical digital twins of neural interfaces.

pmc-13287588.title: Bioremediation of heavy metal contamination: recent developments and future directions
pmc-13287588.creator: Xianmang Xu, Maria Augustyniak, Debasis Chakrabarty, Abhiroop Chowdhury, Sundaram Gunasekaran

pmc-13434261.title: Granzyme K CD8⁺ T cells with tissue-resident features promote intestinal inflammation in patients with Crohn’s disease
pmc-13434261.creator: Yoonho Lee, Tae-Young Kim, Yongjae Kim, Jiwon Baek, Hwan Park, Do Kyung Yoon, Sung Wook Hwang, Jong Lyul Lee, Sang Hyoung Park, Jihun Kim, Suk-Kyun Yang, Buhm Han, Mi-Na Kweon, Kyuyoung Song, Yong Sik Yoon, Byong Duk Ye, Ho-Su Lee
pmc-13434261.description: The role of CD8+ T cells in Crohn’s disease (CD) pathogenesis remains incompletely understood. This study aimed to characterize CD8+ T cells in CD and elucidate their potential contribution to intestinal inflammation. T cells from blood and intestinal tissues of 15 patients with CD were analyzed using single-cell RNA and T cell receptor sequencing.

uslaw-usc-t10-s7417.title: 10 U.S.C. § 7417 — Military history fellowships
uslaw-usc-t10-s7417.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s7417.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part III (Training); Chapter 751 (Training Generally). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Fellowships.— The Secretary of the Army shall prescribe regulations under which the Secretary may award fellowships in military history of the Army to the persons described in subsection (b). (b) Eligible Persons.— The persons eligible for awards of fellowships under this section.

uslaw-usc-t26-s723.title: 26 U.S.C. § 723 — Basis of property contributed to partnership
uslaw-usc-t26-s723.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t26-s723.description: United States Code, Title 26 (Internal Revenue Code); Chapter 1 (Normal Taxes And Surtaxes); Subchapter K (Partners And Partnerships); Part II (Contributions, Distributions, And Transfers); Subpart A (Contributions To A Partnership). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The basis of property contributed to a partnership by a partner shall be the adjusted basis of such property to the contributing partner at the time.
